name: universal-format
description: Silently formats Shell, Java, Kotlin, JS/TS, Python, Go, JSON, YAML, Markdown, CSS, SCSS and PHP files on Write/Edit using each language's standard formatter. Prettier languages (JS/TS, JSON, YAML, Markdown, CSS, SCSS) are formatted in-process before the write by a warm prettier inside a plugin-local MCP server (PreToolUse), using a project's own prettier when present, else a prettier on PATH (after the write), else a plugin-managed copy it installs on demand, else npx as a last resort; non-prettier languages are formatted after the write via each tool's CLI (shfmt, google-java-format/clang-format, ktlint/ktfmt, ruff/black, goimports/gofmt, php-cs-fixer). Honors .editorconfig and tool-native configs; skips prettier's default 80-column printWidth for JSON/YAML when the project has no line-length preference of its own; no-op when no formatter is available. Always active once installed — no on/off toggle.
